INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language
